decisions: Module registration: ssi_gate.rs is registered as a #[path] child module of crate::ssi (crate::ssi::ssi_gate) so lib.rs (outside write_allow) stays untouched and the gate can reuse the SSI module's private composed-normal-net and 2-D hull substrate (FSSI-ELEV: exact Bernstein product nets, never the naive pairing).

Verdict vocabulary: per-box {TangencyFree, Subdivide, Suspect(...)} maps onto Result<GateAdmission, SsiRefusal> as Ok(TangencyFree{margin}) / Ok(Subdivide) (single-level probe, GateParams::max_level == 0) / Err(SsiRefusal::*Suspected{margin}) at the admission-budget halt. TangencyFree margin is the certified enclosure of min_{B1xB2} ||n_X x n_Y|| with a strictly positive lower bound (evidence, never a tolerance).

Suspicion halt: at budget exhaustion the undecided parameter volume history (each level quartering both sides -> cell volume ~ 2^-4k) is classified: u_L/u_0 above STAGNATION_RATIO (area-scale stagnation) -> CoincidentPatchSuspected; otherwise sub-linear shrink -> TangentCurveSuspected. Payload is (undecided measure at halt, per-level shrink exponent). Fires only in the refusal decision.

Cones are CertifiedInterval-only: anchor = enclosure midpoint m, certified sine half-angle bound s_up = radius_up/|m|_lo < 1 (outward rounding), separation certified by sin(alpha)_lb > s_X_up + s_Y_up (alpha the angle between the anchors; asin-superadditivity argument), margin min|n_X| min|n_Y| (sin alpha - s_X - s_Y). No interval trig, no second interval algebra.
Gate is D2-unit-weight only on the spline side (non-unit weight carriers refuse InvalidInput); restricted charts are evaluated directly by interval partials (no polynomialization).

ssi4 live call: the gate is exposed and wired at the restricted-pair entry (gate_admit_restricted_pair next to certify_restricted_pair) but certify_restricted_pair does not branch on it: a whole-carrier box can contain anywhere-parallel normals off the certified branch (e.g. plane x sphere pole), so a live short-circuit would flip a landed green certified verdict (V5). The seam is available to the funnel dispatch; folding is additive and monotone.

Pole composition (theory 4.1): per-box normal enclosures make a collapsed apex row (zero normal on the v=1 row) invisible to an interior box; boxes straddling the pole subdivide toward it and only the surviving cells must certify. Regression pinned by loft_apex_pole_fixture_passes_gate with a machine-checked collapsed row X(u,1)=(0,0,1).

The composed normal-net hull over a nondegenerate box is a sound but loose enclosure (interval de Casteljau dependency on the degree-(2m-1,2n-1) net); the apex fixture therefore uses a modest interior box and an admission budget (max_cells 300000, max_level 24) letting the separable cones separate - never tuned by weakening a refused box.
stop_conditions: none triggered: no new hull kernel was required (the separable composition certified on the existing per-side substrate) and the suspicion halt distinguishes area-scale from sub-linear shrinkage on the fixtures via the measured u_L/u_0 ratio.
